description: Rules under Legal Metrology (PC) and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules (Part XV).

requirements.title: Cosmetic Product Name
requirements.description: Clear statement of identity and nature of the cosmetic.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure cosmetic generic name (e.g., Shampoo, Body Lotion) is visible.

requirements.title: Net Content (ml / g)
requirements.description: Net weight (g) or volume (ml) in standard SI units.
requirements.recommendation_template: Verify net volume/weight in standard metric units.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
requirements.recommendation_template: Print MRP with tax inclusion notice.

requirements.title: Expiry / Best Before Date
requirements.legal_reference: Drugs & Cosmetics Rules / LM PC Rules
requirements.description: Date of expiry or 'Use before' statement.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print 'Best before XX months from mfg' or expiry date.

requirements.title: Manufacturer Name & Address
requirements.description: Name and principal address of the manufacturer.
requirements.recommendation_template: State complete manufacturer / packer postal address.

requirements.title: Consumer Care Information
requirements.description: Consumer helpline, contact email, and address.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure contact number and email for consumer grievances are printed.
